PATNA HIGH COURT
NOTICE
With regard to filling up of the vacancies in the cadre of District Judge (Entry
Level), against 10% quota for the year 2023-24.
In Continuation of the Court's Notice dated 04.08.2025, this is for information to
all the concerned that the written examination for promotion to the cadre of District
Judge (Entry Level), under 10% quota for the year 2023-24 against 16 vacancies shall now
be held on 12.10.2025 {Sunday) in two sittings, 1st sitting from 10:30 A.M . to 1:30 P.M
(Law Paper) and the 2nd sitting from 3:00 P.M. to 5:00 P.M. (Judgment Writing) in the
premises of the Patna High Court, Patna.
Further that Law Paper shall comprise of 30% objective questions of multiple
choice type and 70% descriptive type questions. The objective questions shall be
answered on OMR Answer sheets. Further, BNSS, BSA and BNS have also been added in
the syllabus already communicated for the aforesaid 14th Limited Departmental
Competitive Examination.
